channel.title: Kabuki Kool
channel.desc: Kabuki often depicts traditional Japanese dishes. Actor Kataoka Ainosuke introduces scenes with several examples, and teaches us about what foods were popular in the Edo period. In \"Hokaibo,\" a disreputable begging priest takes time off from abducting a beautiful girl for a bowl of soba noodles from a roadside stall.
